summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds ControlType.SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in ControlCode. rich/control.py adds the format entry "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and Control.title(title). rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(title) -> bool, gated only on is_terminal, with a Google-style docstring. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one elif branch calling term.set_title(title). Tests added in tests/test_console.py (test_set_window_title, skips on legacy_windows), tests/test_control.py (test_control_title), and tests/test_windows_renderer.py (test_control_set_window_title, Windows only). CHANGELOG.md gets one Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200. Tests and mypy were not run, per instructions; nothing was committed.
